correctness.rationale: Bound q|D|>=2(v-1) follows from regularity, induced connectedness, and outside domination. Sharp equality proves induced tree and unique selected exterior neighbor; unique joins/intersections and forbidden induced 6-cycles force a flag full line/pencil. Tree interior sets, distinct flag intersections, line-graph distance bound and attained distance three establish the remaining exact claims. Self-contained independent complete enumerations q=2 (all 2^14 subsets) and q=3 (all 1,562,275 size-eight subsets) corroborate the analytic proof. No finite experiment is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Determines the complete optimum for connected domination of every existing finite projective-plane incidence graph (including non-Desarguesian), counts optimal maximum-leaf spanning trees via a unique-attachment bijection, and proves a sharp change from entirely frozen optimum single/batched exchanges to an explicitly connected line graph at exactly q simultaneous swaps. This supplies a natural and structurally informative extremal-plus-reconfiguration classification beyond ordinary domination counts.
